target_customer: Brands, from Fortune 100 companies to scale-ups, that want to shape how AI models describe them
problem: AI models form opinions about brands that go-to-market teams cannot see or influence.
business_model: Agency services plus software (Agent Analytics free trial, AgentDesk per seat)
product_category: AI visibility and generative engine optimization services

founders.name: Keller Maloney
education: Princeton (water polo All-American, per YC page)

technical_complexity.rationale: Applies black-box probing of LLM behavior to brand perception; moderate research content but mostly services and content infrastructure.

defensibility.rationale: Methodology and services are easy to copy, and many GEO vendors appeared within a year.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Not sourced; search results show many generative engine optimization startups (Profound, Athena) emerging from August 2024 onward.

market_need_then: Brands began asking how ChatGPT and Claude describe them as AI search grew; customer logos on the site (Reducto, Astronomer, Stats Perform) show demand later on.

branding.domain_note: Uses unusual.ai; no source on how obtained. Unusual Ventures is an unrelated VC firm.

identity.voice_and_tone: Direct, thesis-led: 'Market to AI agents', 'Make AI an advocate for your brand'

brand_strength.rationale: The category phrase 'market to AI' is memorable and used in press, but no community or merch evidence.

outcome_analysis: Unusual is active with a team of four at the batch and raised a 3.6 million dollar seed in January 2026. Timing helped as brands rushed to manage how AI models describe them. The category drew many entrants quickly and the service model is easy to copy, so durability is uncertain. Customer logos suggest early enterprise traction.
notes: Round date reported as January 5 or January 10 2026 by different outlets; investor lists differ slightly. Competition list empty because no sources dated near fall 2024 were found; Profound reports an August 2024 founding on its own site. Funding before 2026 not found.
